source: Local installed sts2.dll; static inspection only. No native code or live RNG is invoked.

semantics.base_weight: Relative random weight before repeat restrictions, cooldowns and conditions; not an unconditional probability.
semantics.max_consecutive: Maximum consecutive selections, not a branch weight.
semantics.cooldown: Disallow if this move occurred among the last N moves.
semantics.condition: Conditional branches take the first true predicate. Predicates are unevaluated; never assume private flags or missing history.
semantics.rule_references: Rule types directly referenced by the named move method. References are not confirmed effects: conditions, quantities, recipients, destinations, helper methods and timing are not inferred. They never add powers or cards to the observed state.

generated_cards.scope: Per native call if reached while this move resolves. Guards, repetitions, targets, modifiers, interruptions and destination overflow are not simulated. This does not add cards to the observed piles.

power_applications.scope: Native call arguments per invocation if reached. Conditions, loops, target availability, modifiers, prevention and duration are not simulated. Amount is not a resulting stack; referenced rules and live values take precedence over generic Wiki move summaries.
